During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] was the site of a '''battle''' between the two galactic powers.<ref name="The Setting" /> The ice planet was a holy world to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], but it served as a staging ground for surprise attacks by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the war as a result of its unknown location and difficult-to-navigate hyperlanes.<ref name="Ilum Landing">{{TORcite|type=codex|Ilum Landing Zone}}</ref> Even after the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] attack, the planet would remain in the hands of the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] until several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]<ref name="Holonet" /> in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline" />

==Behind the scenes==
A battle on Ilum during the Great Galactic War was first mentioned in the article "The Setting", on ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' website in [[October]] [[2008]]. However, any mention of this battle, as well as the [[Battle of Dathomir (Great Galactic War)|battle of Dathomir]], was removed following an update of the website in [[June]] [[2011]].<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/story/setting|text=Game Setting|nolive=1}}</ref>
